title: Exa Search + Contents input
description: Search the web with Exa and return highlighted excerpts from each result.

searchType.title: Search depth
searchType.description: Use Auto for the default Exa search experience or Deep for broader recall and query expansion.

numResults.title: Number of results
numResults.description: Maximum number of search results to return (1-20). The first 10 results and their contents are included in the base price; results beyond 10 add to the cost.

includeDomains.title: Include domains
includeDomains.description: Only return results from these domains.

maxCharacters.title: Max highlight characters
maxCharacters.description: Optional character cap for each returned Exa highlight. Highlights are always returned.

additionalQueries.title: Additional deep queries
additionalQueries.description: Optional query variations used by Deep search.

systemPrompt.title: System prompt
systemPrompt.description: Optional system prompt for Deep search structured output. Ignored unless Search depth is Deep.

outputSchema.title: Structured output schema
outputSchema.description: Optional JSON schema sent to Exa for structured output. Ignored unless Search depth is Deep.

extraRequestOptions.title: Extra request options
extraRequestOptions.description: Advanced Exa API request fields to merge into the outgoing payload.
